name: Brochuchus
sum: Early to Middle Miocene crocodile from Kenya and Saudi Arabia, a close relative of the living dwarf crocodiles.
holotype: Type material of "Crocodylus" pigotti from Rusinga Island, Lake Victoria, Kenya.
material: Skulls and skeletons of two species.
biology: A generalized crocodylid with a long, narrow snout and robust skeleton, probably a predator that spent much time in water.
author: Conrad et al. 2013

sources.text: Conrad, J. L.; Jenkins, K.; Lehmann, T.; Manthi, F. K.; Peppe, D. J.; Nightingale, S.; Cossette, A.; Dunsworth, H. M.; Harcourt-Smith, W. E. H.; McNulty, K. P. 2013.
